title: Be Strong, Don’t Be Afraid
traveler_why: Tonight is Isaiah telling frightened people to be strong, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler who does exactly that — he felt nervous about the bike with no training wheels, took a deep breath and pushed off anyway, and the wobble turned into riding and then into pure joy, which is the shape of Isaiah 35 at a four-year-old's height.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because his courage carries him all the way to joy. In Beau’s world today: Beau felt nervous about riding his bike without training wheels — it seemed so hard and a little scary. But he remembered to be strong and not afraid, took a deep breath, and pushed off. Wobble, wobble — then he was riding! He leaped off, cheering with pure joy. Just like Isaiah said, “Be strong, don’t be afraid,” Beau’s brave heart turned into a happy, joyful one.
